timothy-w-chilton@VA.notes_append: sheriff-roy 2026-10-07: border_immigration q2 = false from Chilton's 2023 candidate quote (as reported by Bolts, citing the Culpeper Star-Exponent) that local and state officers should not enforce federal law, said about Culpeper's 287(g) program. Bolts also notes he had not said whether he would exit 287(g).

2.note: Bolts (2023, on Culpeper's 287(g) program), quoting Chilton: "I don't think local and state people should be enforcing any type of federal law."
